whatItDoes: Estimates the monthly payment, total interest, and full payoff term for a fixed-rate mortgage. Uses standard amortization math to model what a home loan really costs.
whyItExists: A mortgage is the largest debt most households take on, and the gap between interest rates and terms can shift the total cost by hundreds of thousands. An amortization calculator makes the real price of a loan visible before you commit.
whoShouldUse: Homebuyers, real-estate agents, financial planners, and anyone comparing mortgage offers or payoff paths.
useCases: Estimate a mortgage monthly payment for a target home price
Compare the total interest of a shorter vs. longer term
Model additional payments that shorten the payoff term
Check how a rate change shifts the total mortgage cost
instructions: Enter the home price you plan to finance
Enter the annual mortgage interest rate as a percent
Choose the term in years (15 and 30 are common)
Read the monthly payment, total interest, and payoff term
examples: $350,000 at 6.5% for 30 years -> payment approx $2,212, total interest approx $446,000
$350,000 at 6.5% for 15 years -> payment approx $3,050, total interest approx $199,000
$750,000 at 5.75% for 30 years -> payment approx $4,376, total interest approx $825,000
bestPractices: Compare the total-interest rows, not only the payment
Only choose the shorter term if the higher payment is definitely affordable
Add property tax, insurance, and HOA fees on top of the payment
Re-run the numbers if rates move by a quarter point
commonMistakes: Leaving out property tax, insurance, and HOA in the budget
Financing up to the top of an approval range without a rate buffer
Basing a decision on a teaser rate that expires before closing
Assuming an adjustable term behaves like a fixed 30-year loan
faq: Does this include escrow for taxes and insurance? — No, it covers principal and interest only.
What does total interest mean? — The portion of all your payments that goes to the lender as interest.
Can I model a shorter term? — Yes, set the term to 15 or 20 years to compare payoffs.
Is my data shared? — No, every calculation runs locally in your browser.
features: Monthly payment, total interest, and payoff term
Adjustable home price, rate, and term
